youtubeTitle: The map that took decades to draw still holds because someone did the boring part right the first...
caption:
The map that took decades to draw still holds because someone did the boring part right the first time.

Nobody remembers the years of committee meetings and boundary disputes - they just live inside the result. Whatever unglamorous groundwork you're doing today is the same kind of bet: on something outlasting the credit for having built it.
